raw_text:
AI Project Intelligence Architecture Overview

The system uses a multi-agent structure to provide automated risk detection, delivery forecasting, and blocker analysis for software engineering initiatives.

Milestone 1 focuses on document ingestion, content normalization, sentence-transformers embedding generation, and ChromaDB vector indexing.
